#   canvas prefix + this text with {DESC} replaced by the item's DESC.

#   - lines starting with '#' are stripped; everything else is joined into

#   - keep it ASCII (no em-dashes / curly quotes — they break JS injection).
#   - {DESC} must appear exactly once.
#   - the mid-grey fallback sentence is auto-swapped to blue-grey for
#     skymetal/rivetmail/flint/iron items; if you reword that sentence,

# Canvas prefixes (edit in status.py CANVAS if needed):
#   P: "Generate an image, no commentary. Vertical portrait canvas (2:3 aspect ratio). "

Dark low-fantasy action-RPG inventory item icon in the style of Path of
Exile and Diablo 2: {DESC}. A complete, solid, three-dimensional object
shown from a dynamic three-quarter hero angle (tilted, seen partly from
the side and slightly above) with real depth and volume, presented in
the round. The item is large and fills the frame edge to edge; if it is
long it lies on a bold diagonal spanning corner to corner. Dramatic
high-contrast game lighting: a strong directional key light from the
upper left, deep neutral shadows, and a crisp cool rim light catching
the silhouette. Rendered like a sharply modeled, high-detail 3D game
asset: crisp hard edges, precise surface detail, photoreal material
textures. Neutral-to-cold white balance - deep neutral blacks,
slate-grey shadows, bone-white highlights; warm tones only where the
material itself is warm, never an overall wash; no sepia, no yellow
cast, no amber haze, no vignette. Clean readable material surfaces with
subtle use-wear only, made only of the materials named. Rendered as a
PNG with a fully TRANSPARENT background - true alpha transparency, no
background at all, NOT a painted checkerboard pattern. If transparency
is impossible, fall back to one flat uniform mid-grey fill. The object
casts NO shadow; nothing behind or around the object - no ground plane,
no drop shadow, no gradient, no vignette, no text, no watermark, no
frame.
